mapper.select: select role.role_key from role join person_role on role.id = person_role.role_id where person_role.person_id = #{personId} and role.status = 0 and role.deleted = 0

select role.id, role.role_key, role.name, role.status, role.remark from role join person_role on role.id = person_role.role_id where person_role.person_id = #{personId} and role.status = 0 and role.deleted = 0

select r.id, r.role_key, r.name, r.status, r.remark, r.created_time, r.created_by, r.updated_time, r.updated_by, create_user.username as createdByName, update_user.username as updatedByName from role r left join user create_user on r.created_by = create_user.id left join user update_user on r.updated_by = update_user.id where r.id = #{id} and r.status = 0 and r.deleted = 0
